title: आरव, गेंद और खाट का दूसरा सिरा
title_alts: आरव की गेंद भारी खाट के नीचे जा छिपी
खाट के नीचे गई गेंद, और दूसरे सिरे की खुली जगह
description_hook: आरव की गेंद आँगन में भारी खाट के नीचे जा छिपी। बड़े लोग एक ही सिरे पर झुके रहे, और आरव ने दूसरा सिरा देख लिया।

characters.name: आरव
characters.description: seven-year-old boy, short black hair, blue kurta and grey shorts, a small scab on his right knee

scenes.narration: आरव आँगन में गेंद उछाल रहा था। गेंद लुढ़ककर भारी खाट के नीचे छिप गई।
scenes.caption: Aarav was tossing his ball in the courtyard when it slipped under the heavy cot.
scenes.image_brief: Aarav, a seven-year-old boy with short black hair in a blue kurta and grey shorts, standing on the brick floor of a courtyard beside a low stone well, watching his red ball roll under a heavy wooden cot. Bright morning sunlight.

scenes.narration: उसने हाथ अंदर डाला। उँगलियाँ गेंद तक नहीं पहुँचीं। साथ बोलो: गेंद, गेंद, तुम कहाँ छिपी?
scenes.caption: His hand went in; his fingers fell short. Say with me: ball, ball, where are you hiding?
scenes.image_brief: Aarav lying on the courtyard bricks with one arm stretched into the shadow under the wooden cot, his fingertips stopping short of the red ball. The stone well stands behind him in warm morning light.

scenes.narration: आरव ने खाट दो बार खींची। वह हिली नहीं। बड़े उसी सिरे पर झुके रहे।
scenes.caption: Aarav tugged the cot twice. It did not budge. The grown-ups stayed at that same end.
scenes.image_brief: Aarav pulling hard on the wooden frame of the heavy cot with both hands while the cot stays still; two adults crouch at the same near end of the cot, looking underneath it. Sunlit brick courtyard with a stone well at the side.

scenes.narration: कंधा दुखने लगा। हथेली धूल से भर गई। ज़ोर से बोलो: गेंद, गेंद, तुम कहाँ छिपी?
scenes.caption: His shoulder ached, his palm full of dust. Shout it: ball, ball, where are you hiding?
scenes.image_brief: Aarav sitting back on his heels beside the wooden cot, rubbing one shoulder, his dusty palm turned upward, the red ball still resting in the shadow under the cot. Strong midday light on the courtyard bricks near the well.

scenes.narration: तभी आरव ने खाट के दूसरे सिरे पर झाँका। वहाँ चौड़ी जगह खुली थी।
scenes.caption: Then Aarav peeked at the far end of the cot. A wide gap stood open there.
scenes.image_brief: Aarav crouching at the far end of the wooden cot, peering into a wide open gap beneath it where the red ball sits in shade, while two adults remain bent at the opposite end. Sunlit courtyard with a stone well.

scenes.narration: आरव उधर लेट गया और हाथ सरकाया। गेंद हथेली में आई। मन खिल उठा।
scenes.caption: He lay down there and slid his hand in. The ball met his palm. His heart lit up.
scenes.image_brief: Aarav lying flat at the far end of the cot with his hand reaching through the wide gap, the red ball rolling into his open palm, a small smile on his face. Afternoon light across the courtyard bricks beside the well.

scenes.narration: आरव ने गेंद छाती से लगा ली। फिर हँसकर बोला: गेंद, गेंद, तुम कहाँ छिपी?
scenes.caption: Aarav hugged the ball to his chest, then laughed: ball, ball, where are you hiding?
scenes.image_brief: Aarav standing in the courtyard hugging the red ball against his chest and laughing, the heavy wooden cot and the stone well behind him. Soft golden late-afternoon light.

title: तारा, कबीर और बरामदे के पार जाने वाला भरा घड़ा
title_alts: तारा का घड़ा अकेले हिलता ही नहीं था
जब भरा घड़ा बरामदे के बीच में रुक गया
description_hook: बरामदे के एक सिरे पर लबालब भरा घड़ा है और दूसरे सिरे पर तारा की कक्षा। अकेले वह घड़ा हिलता भी नहीं, तो तारा एक और जोड़ी हाथ ढूँढ़ती है।

characters.name: तारा
characters.description: eight years old, two thick black braids tied with red ribbon, blue school pinafore and white socks, a smudge of chalk dust on one knee

characters.name: कबीर
characters.description: eight years old, short cropped hair, grey school shorts and a white shirt with rolled sleeves, one front tooth missing

scenes.narration: तारा भरा घड़ा बरामदे के पार ले जाना चाहती थी।
scenes.caption: Tara wanted to carry the full water pot across the veranda.
scenes.image_brief: Tara, a girl of eight with two braids and a blue school pinafore, stands on a stone school veranda beside a wide clay pot filled to the brim with water. Morning light comes through the arches and lies in stripes on the floor.

scenes.narration: तारा ने दोनों हाथ लगाकर ज़ोर लगाया। घड़ा हिला भी नहीं! दो हाथ नहीं, चार हाथ।
scenes.caption: Tara pushed with both hands. The pot did not move. Not two hands, four hands.
scenes.image_brief: Tara bends over the clay pot on the veranda, both hands gripping its rim, shoulders straining. The pot sits flat on the stone floor and has not shifted. Sunlight from the courtyard falls across her back.

scenes.narration: फिर तारा ने घड़ा घसीटा! पानी छलका और फ़र्श गीला हो गया।
scenes.caption: Then Tara dragged the pot. Water splashed out and wet the floor.
scenes.image_brief: Tara crouches low and drags the clay pot a short way along the veranda floor. Water slops over the rim and spreads in a dark wet patch across the stone. Bright daylight from the open courtyard.

scenes.narration: तारा की बाँहें दुखने लगीं और हथेलियाँ फिसलने लगीं। मेरे साथ एक गहरी साँस लो।
scenes.caption: Tara's arms began to ache and her palms slipped. Take one deep breath with me.
scenes.image_brief: Tara stands upright beside the clay pot on the veranda, shaking out her red hands, her open palms wet and shining. The pot is still only halfway along the floor. Warm light from the courtyard.

scenes.narration: तभी तारा को सूझा। उसने कबीर को बुलाया और दूसरा किनारा थमा दिया! दो हाथ नहीं, चार हाथ।
scenes.caption: Tara had an idea. She called Kabir to the other side. Not two hands, four hands.
scenes.image_brief: Tara waves to Kabir, a boy of eight in grey school shorts, and guides his hands onto the far rim of the clay pot while she holds the near rim. They face each other over the pot on the veranda in daylight.

scenes.narration: तारा और कबीर ने साथ उठाया, और घड़ा हल्का लगा। क्या तुम भी साथ कदम गिनोगे?
scenes.caption: Tara and Kabir lifted together and the pot felt light. Will you count the steps too?
scenes.image_brief: Tara and Kabir carry the clay pot between them, one hand each on the rim, walking side by side down the long school veranda. The water inside is steady. Sunlight from the arches falls on both children.

scenes.narration: बरामदा पार हुआ, घड़ा पूरा भरा रहा। तारा की हँसी छूट गई! दो हाथ नहीं, चार हाथ।
scenes.caption: Across at last, the pot still full. Tara laughed. Not two hands, four hands.
scenes.image_brief: Tara and Kabir set the full clay pot down at the far end of the veranda outside a classroom door. Tara is laughing with her head tipped back and Kabir grins beside her. The water surface is calm and bright.

title: विवान और आँगन की तीन आवाज़ें
title_alts: विवान को अँधेरे आँगन से डर लगता था
जब आँगन की लालटेन हवा में बुझ गई
description_hook: गाँव का आँगन रात में बहुत बड़ा लगता है। विवान उसे रोशन करने चला था, और सुनना सीख गया।

characters.name: विवान
characters.description: six-year-old boy, short black hair, white vest and blue shorts, a red thread tied on his right wrist

scenes.narration: विवान आँगन की देहरी पर रुक गया। रात बहुत काली थी। उसे आँगन भर रोशनी चाहिए थी।
scenes.caption: Vivaan stops on the courtyard step. The night is black. He wants light everywhere.
scenes.image_brief: Vivaan, a six-year-old boy in a white vest and blue shorts with a red thread on his wrist, standing barefoot on the raised step of a village courtyard at night, one hand on the wooden doorframe, the courtyard beyond him dark, a thin strip of lamplight from the room behind him falling on his feet.

scenes.narration: विवान ने लालटेन जलाई। हवा चली, लौ बुझ गई। अँधेरा सुनो, अँधेरा बोलता है।
scenes.caption: Vivaan lights a lantern. Wind blows, the flame dies. Listen, the dark speaks.
scenes.image_brief: Vivaan crouching beside a small glass lantern in the middle of a mud-walled village courtyard at night, the flame just gone out with a curl of smoke rising from the wick, his face lit only by pale moonlight.

scenes.narration: फिर उसने टॉर्च ढूँढी, लेकिन बैटरी मर चुकी थी। कोने अब भी काले थे।
scenes.caption: Then he finds a torch, but the battery is dead. The corners stay black.
scenes.image_brief: Vivaan kneeling on the swept floor of the village courtyard, an open metal torch in his hands and two spent batteries lying beside his knee, the corners of the courtyard in deep shadow, faint moonlight on a clay water pot.

scenes.narration: आँगन बहुत बड़ा लगा। विवान का दिल तेज़ धड़का। मेरे साथ गहरी साँस लो।
scenes.caption: The courtyard feels huge. Vivaan's heart pounds. Take a deep breath with me.
scenes.image_brief: Vivaan standing alone in the middle of the wide village courtyard, eyes squeezed shut and both fists pressed against his chest, dark walls and a black open doorway around him, only starlight overhead.

scenes.narration: आँखें बंद थीं, तभी विवान ने सुना। झींगुर। नल की टप। नीम की सरसराहट। अँधेरा सुनो, अँधेरा बोलता है।
scenes.caption: Eyes shut, Vivaan hears. A cricket. A tap. Neem leaves. Listen, the dark speaks.
scenes.image_brief: Vivaan standing still in the village courtyard with his eyes closed and his head tilted to one side, a cricket on the wall beside him, a tap dripping into a steel bucket near his feet, and a neem tree stirring above the wall, starlight on the ground.

scenes.narration: विवान ने तीन आवाज़ें गिनीं। मेरे साथ गिनो। अब उसे रोशनी नहीं, आवाज़ें चाहिए थीं।
scenes.caption: Vivaan counts three sounds. Count with me. Now he wants sounds, not light.
scenes.image_brief: Vivaan smiling and holding up three fingers in the village courtyard at night, the cricket on the wall, the dripping tap and the neem tree behind him, moonlight across his face and the courtyard floor.

scenes.narration: विवान चारपाई पर लेटा, कान खुले। डर अब छोटा लगा। अँधेरा सुनो, अँधेरा बोलता है।
scenes.caption: Vivaan lies on the cot, ears open. The fear feels small. Listen, the dark speaks.
scenes.image_brief: Vivaan lying on a rope cot in the middle of the dark village courtyard, a thin cotton sheet over his legs, eyes open and calm, the neem tree and the star-filled sky above him.

title: अनाया, शीशे वाली गुड़िया और बरामदे का खेल
title_alts: अनाया को वो नाचने वाली गुड़िया चाहिए थी
शीशे के पीछे गुड़िया नाच रही थी, बरामदा खाली था
description_hook: अनाया रोज़ शाम दुकान के शीशे पर वही नाचती गुड़िया देखती थी। जिस शाम उसने शीशे में अपनी परछाईं देखी, उसे पता चला कि उसे असल में क्या चाहिए था।

characters.name: अनाया
characters.description: seven-year-old girl, straight black hair cut to her shoulders, yellow kurta, a red thread tied on her wrist

characters.name: छोटा भाई
characters.description: four-year-old boy, curly hair, red shorts and a white vest, always barefoot

scenes.narration: अनाया रोज़ शाम शीशे के पीछे नाचती गुड़िया देखती थी। उसे वही गुड़िया चाहिए थी।
scenes.caption: Every evening Anaya watched the dancing doll behind the glass. She wanted that one.
scenes.image_brief: Anaya, a seven-year-old girl with short straight bob hair, a yellow kurta and a red thread on her wrist, standing on a city footpath with both palms on a toy shop window, a dancing doll in a pink dress on the shelf inside, warm evening light spilling out of the shop.

scenes.narration: अनाया ने गुल्लक उलटकर सिक्के गिने। मेरे साथ गिनो, एक, दो, तीन। सिक्के कम थे।
scenes.caption: Anaya tipped out her piggy bank and counted. Count with me: one, two, three. Too few.
scenes.image_brief: Anaya sitting cross-legged on a veranda floor beside an upturned clay piggy bank, a small pile of coins spread in front of her, counting them on her fingers, late afternoon sunlight lying across the floor.

scenes.narration: अनाया ने मोज़े की गुड़िया बनाई। तुम घूमो, मैं ताली बजाऊँ। मोज़ा गिर गया।
scenes.caption: Anaya made a doll out of a sock. You spin, I clap. The sock just fell over.
scenes.image_brief: Anaya on the veranda holding up a doll she has made from a rolled grey sock with button eyes, the sock doll slipping out of her fingers towards the floor, dim light coming from an open doorway behind her.

scenes.narration: शीशे पर अनाया की परछाईं अकेली थी। उसका गला भारी हुआ, आँखें भर आईं।
scenes.caption: On the glass, Anaya's reflection stood alone. Her throat felt heavy, her eyes filled.
scenes.image_brief: Anaya standing alone at dusk outside the lit toy shop, her own reflection showing on the window glass next to the dancing doll, the street behind her empty, her eyes wet.

scenes.narration: तभी अनाया रुकी। तुम घूमो, मैं ताली बजाऊँ। वह शीशे से कह रही थी, दोस्त से नहीं।
scenes.caption: Then Anaya stopped. You spin, I clap. She was saying it to glass, not to a friend.
scenes.image_brief: Anaya standing very still in front of the toy shop window with one hand lifted halfway as if about to clap, looking at her own reflection instead of at the doll, evening shop light on her face.

scenes.narration: अनाया ने छोटे भाई को बुलाया। मेरे साथ ताली बजाओ। भाई घूमा, अनाया खिलखिला पड़ी।
scenes.caption: Anaya called her little brother over. Clap with me. He spun, and she burst out laughing.
scenes.image_brief: Anaya on the veranda clapping with both hands raised while her younger brother, a four-year-old boy with curly hair in red shorts and a white vest, spins on one foot in front of her, warm light from a doorway lamp, the grey sock doll lying on the step.

scenes.narration: गुड़िया अब भी शीशे में थी। अनाया का मन हल्का था। तुम घूमो, मैं ताली बजाऊँ।
scenes.caption: The doll was still behind the glass. Anaya felt light. You spin, I clap.
scenes.image_brief: Anaya and her younger brother sitting side by side on the veranda step, breathing hard and grinning at each other, the lit toy shop small and far away down the street at dusk.

title: सिया की एक चरखी और आम के बाग का नन्हा बच्चा
title_alts: सिया के पास एक ही चरखी थी, और बच्चा रो रहा था
जब चरखी घूमी ही नहीं, तो वह किसके हाथ में गई?
description_hook: आम के बाग में सिया के पास सिर्फ़ एक काग़ज़ की चरखी है। एक नन्हा बच्चा अपनी मुड़ी चरखी लिए रो रहा है, और आगे क्या करना है यह सिया खुद तय करती है।

characters.name: सिया
characters.description: six years old, two long braids tied with red ribbon, yellow kurta and loose red shorts, carries a small blue paper windmill on a stick

scenes.narration: सिया आम के बाग में दौड़ी, काग़ज़ की चरखी लिए। वह चाहती थी, चरखी घूमे।
scenes.caption: Siya runs through the mango orchard with a paper windmill she wants to spin.
scenes.image_brief: Siya, a six-year-old girl with two braids in a yellow kurta and red shorts, running between rows of mango trees holding a small blue paper windmill on a stick, fallen mangoes on the dirt path, morning sunlight coming through the leaves

scenes.narration: सिया ने फूँका। हवा सो गई थी। मेरे साथ कहो। घूम चरखी, घूम हवा में।
scenes.caption: She blows hard, but the air is asleep. Say it with me: spin, windmill, spin!
scenes.image_brief: Siya standing still between two mango trees, cheeks puffed out, blowing at the blue paper windmill held close to her mouth, the windmill petals completely still, dust hanging in the warm morning light

scenes.narration: वह दौड़ी, चरखी ऊपर उठाकर। पंखुड़ियाँ दो बार घूमीं, फिर रुकीं। सिया हाँफने लगी।
scenes.caption: She runs with it held high. Two turns, then it stops. Siya is out of breath.
scenes.image_brief: Siya running along a row of mango trees with the blue paper windmill raised above her head, braids flying out behind her, face flushed and mouth open with breathing hard, bright midday light and tree shadows striping the ground

scenes.narration: पेड़ के नीचे नन्हा बच्चा रो रहा था। उसकी चरखी मुड़ी थी। सिया की मुट्ठी कस गई।
scenes.caption: Under the tree a smaller boy cries. His windmill is bent. Siya's fist tightens.
scenes.image_brief: A small boy about three years old sitting on the ground under a mango tree, crying, holding a bent and crumpled pink paper windmill; Siya standing one step away with her fist closed tight around her own blue windmill, patchy light under the branches

scenes.narration: सिया ने अपनी चरखी देखी, फिर उसके नन्हे हाथ। उसने चरखी बढ़ा दी। घूम चरखी, घूम हवा में।
scenes.caption: Siya looks at her windmill, then at his small hands, and holds it out to him.
scenes.image_brief: Siya crouching in front of the small crying boy under the mango tree, holding her blue paper windmill out to him with both hands, his wet face turned up towards her, the bent pink windmill lying in the grass beside him, soft afternoon light

scenes.narration: बच्चा दौड़ा, चरखी घूम उठी। तुम भी फूँको। सिया हँसी, हाथ खाली, मन हल्का।
scenes.caption: He runs and the windmill spins. Blow with me! Siya laughs, hands empty, heart light.
scenes.image_brief: The small boy running across the grass of the mango orchard with Siya's blue paper windmill spinning fast in his raised hand; Siya standing behind him with empty open hands, laughing, warm late afternoon light between the trees

scenes.narration: सिया ने उसे दौड़ते देखा, और मुस्कुराई। घूम चरखी, घूम हवा में।
scenes.caption: Siya watches him run and smiles. Spin, windmill, spin in the wind.
scenes.image_brief: Siya sitting on a thick mango tree root, chin on her knees, smiling as she watches the small boy run in the distance with the spinning blue windmill, long warm shadows stretching across the orchard
